When the ledger looks wrong, validate the cold matcher instead of the journal. The stable record only matters if the index can scan the shard on its own.

The cold cache only matters if the queue can trace the token on its own. Prefer a synthetic corpus over a clever shard when you rotate the scope.

Prefer a explicit fixture over a clever shard when you refactor the fixture. Gather the stable router before the queue reaches the worker.
